text: I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation here. The clean lines, glass doors, and illuminated displays evoke a space dedicated to knowledge and creation. As I step through the threshold into a vibrant room labeled 'R + D', I sense the hum of ideas—of research and rapid development—each screen and text inviting me to question, to learn, to innovate. It is a place alive with possibility, and I am both observer and participant in this unfolding experiment.
